description: Issue #149 (ADR adr-scope-derivation.md, layer L2), the OTHER half of the two-point measurement in case 45: byte-for-byte the same issue, planned with a profile that declares an rspec mirror. `app/{dir}{base}.rb` -> `spec/{dir}{base}_spec.rb` is a convention no path rule can predict — L1 derives the sibling `app/models/user_spec.rb` and stops — so without the declaration the worker that writes spec/models/user_spec.rb is failed by a scope gate it cannot resolve. The declared companion reaches suspected_files (which dispatch copies into scope.allow verbatim) and is reported in scope_defaults, so nothing is granted silently. Diff this case against 45: only the profile differs.
